description: Per-skill-type BKT and forgetting-curve priors. Starting points for `primer fit`, grouped by the answer format of the skill's probe. A skill maps to the first type listing its probe type; anything unlisted falls to the default type.
note: These are principled defaults informed by the claims they cite, not fitted values. Fitted always beats prior: `primer fit` computed from a family's own evidence overwrites these and nothing here overwrites a fit.

two_choice.rationale: Two or three answers are on the table, so chance alone answers correctly near half the time. Guess sits just under the 0.5 ceiling that keeps the model identifiable.

selected_response.rationale: A small set of options to select among. Chance rate near one in four.

performance.rationale: Extended performance scored against a rubric. Hard to pass by luck, but scoring noise and off days raise slip above the constructed-response prior.

constructed_response.rationale: The child produces the answer: arithmetic, writing, decoding, counting. Producing the right answer without the skill is rare, so guess sits near zero. This is the default for any probe type not listed above.
